note: G38: evolved populations scored on the filtered-MRR yardstick

controls.name: C1_baseline_reproduces_G30_through_this_evaluator
controls.must_fire_because: if the baseline drifts, no arm number in this spike means what it says
controls.can_fail_because: a different confidence basis, split, or filter index would move it while every arm still looked internally consistent
controls.null_must_contain: a G17 exhaustive baseline differing from G30's published 0.063112

controls.name: C2_planted_control_excluded_from_every_arm
controls.must_fire_because: an evolved rule that scored well by learning the A15 plant would be a finding about the plant, not about FB15k-237
controls.can_fail_because: evo.dataset() injects 600 planted edges into train, so the population genuinely can carry them
controls.null_must_contain: a planted predicate id >= npred reaching the evaluator

controls.name: C3_seed_patch_actually_reaches_run
controls.must_fire_because: three seeds are only three samples if the seed changes the population
controls.can_fail_because: if RUN_SEED were bound at definition time rather than read at call time, every 'seed' would be seed 1234 and the range would be a fabrication
controls.null_must_contain: two seeds producing an identical population

controls.name: C4_length1_bodies_are_unreachable_not_merely_undiscovered
controls.must_fire_because: G34's largest single lift is the length-1 class; whether evolution FAILED to find it or CANNOT express it are different findings and only one of them is about search
controls.can_fail_because: contract pops from the body and recombine slices it, so a length-1 body is one unguarded edit away and the guards are what stop it
controls.null_must_contain: a mutate() that admits a body of length 1, or an evolved population containing one

falsifiers.name: F1_evolution_does_not_beat_exhaustive_mining
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the best arm's filtered MRR is <= the 3,198-rule exhaustive baseline
falsifiers.refutes: the evolutionary machinery finds better rules than exhaustive 2-hop mining on the external yardstick
falsifiers.fires_when: the best arm's filtered MRR is <= the 3,198-rule exhaustive baseline

falsifiers.name: F2_evolution_never_left_the_seed_shape
falsifiers.can_fail_because: every body in every evolved population has length exactly 2
falsifiers.refutes: extend/contract actually vary body length in practice
falsifiers.fires_when: every body in every evolved population has length exactly 2
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: An evolved arm exceeds the exhaustive 2-hop baseline on filtered MRR, and evolution produces bodies of length != 2
